import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys
import unittest

import torch


ROOT = pathlib.Path('/fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_c117_hyperbolic_item_semantic_id')
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from model.hyperbolic import exp_0, log_0, hyperbolic_distance
from model.layers import HyperbolicRQLayer


def small_config():
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    return SimpleNamespace(codebook_num=3, codebook_dim=2, codebook_size=(4, 4, 4),
                           vq_type='vq', beta=0.25, sk_epsilon=-1.0, sk_iters=-1)


class HyperbolicGradientFlowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        torch.manual_seed(17)
        torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)

    def tearDown(self):
        torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float32)

    def test_exp_log_roundtrip_has_gradcheck_and_gradient(self):
        v = torch.tensor([[0.13, -0.21], [0.31, 0.07]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(exp_0, (v,), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        recovered = log_0(exp_0(v))
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(recovered, v, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9))
        (recovered.square().sum()).backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(v.grad)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(v.grad).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(v.grad.abs().sum().item(), 1e-6)

    def test_distance_matches_independent_collinear_oracle_and_gradcheck(self):
        # For x=(r,0), y=(s,0), the specified Mobius operator gives
        # D(x,y)=2*atanh(abs((s-r)/(1-r*s))).
        r, s = 0.2, 0.5
        x = torch.tensor([[r, 0.0]], dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.tensor([[s, 0.0]], dtype=torch.float64)
        expected = 2.0 * torch.atanh(torch.tensor(abs((s-r)/(1-r*s)), dtype=torch.float64))
        actual = hyperbolic_distance(x, y)
        self.assertTrue(torch.allclose(actual.squeeze(), expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9))
        xx = torch.tensor([[0.17, -0.08]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        yy = torch.tensor([[-0.11, 0.23]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        self.assertTrue(torch.autograd.gradcheck(hyperbolic_distance, (xx, yy), eps=1e-6, atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-4))
        hyperbolic_distance(xx, yy).sum().backward()
        for grad in (xx.grad, yy.grad):
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad)
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())
            self.assertGreater(grad.abs().sum().item(), 1e-6)

    def test_three_level_quantizer_backpropagates_into_input_and_each_codebook(self):
        layer = HyperbolicRQLayer(small_config()).double().train()
        x = torch.tensor([[0.21, -0.14], [-0.18, 0.27], [0.33, 0.09]],
                         dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        # Loss includes the real quantizer loss and differentiable straight-through
        # output pathway; integer assignment tokens are intentionally not optimized.
        q, qloss, _, tokens = layer(x)
        loss = qloss + 0.37 * q.square().mean()
        self.assertEqual(tuple(tokens.shape), (3, 3))
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss).item())
        loss.backward()
        self.assertIsNotNone(x.grad)
        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(x.grad).all().item())
        self.assertGreater(x.grad.abs().sum().item(), 1e-7)
        self.assertEqual(len(layer.vq_layers), 3)
        for i, quantizer in enumerate(layer.vq_layers):
            grad = quantizer.embed.weight.grad
            self.assertIsNotNone(grad, 'codebook level %d is disconnected' % i)
            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(grad).all().item())
            self.assertGreater(grad.abs().sum().item(), 1e-8, 'codebook level %d has no learning signal' % i)

    def test_nan_input_is_not_silently_reported_as_finite(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[float('nan'), 0.1]], dtype=torch.float64)
        y = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1]], dtype=torch.float64)
        result = hyperbolic_distance(x, y)
        self.assertFalse(torch.isfinite(result).all().item(), 'NaN input was silently hidden')

    def test_detached_geometry_negative_is_detected_as_graph_disconnection(self):
        x = torch.tensor([[0.2, -0.1]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        y = torch.tensor([[-0.1, 0.3]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
        broken = hyperbolic_distance(x.detach(), y.detach()).sum()
        self.assertFalse(broken.requires_grad)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            broken.backward()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
